segment.source: *He*'s nothin' but a slackin', pipeworkin' drop-off. ::Spits.::<end>
segment.target: *He*'s nothin' but a slackin', pipeworkin' drop-off. ::Spits.::<end>

segment.source: My daughter shoulda gone with Dirt instead. He may've been filthy, but he was a real man.<end>
segment.target: My daughter shoulda gone with Dirt instead. He may've been filthy, but he was a real man.<end>

segment.source: If *He* hadn't smashed the monitor in drunken rage, we'd be watchin' the Arena on the whole damn screen!<end>
segment.target: If *He* hadn't smashed the monitor in drunken rage, we'd be watchin' the Arena on the whole damn screen!<end>

segment.source: I told 'er, but she wouldn't listen. She... "loves" Him. Fool!<end>
segment.target: I told 'er, but she wouldn't listen. She... "loves" Him. Fool!<end>

segment.source: I hope He drowns. Maybe then my daughter'll go and find a hardcore man. ::Spits.::<end>
segment.target: I hope He drowns. Maybe then my daughter'll go and find a hardcore man. ::Spits.::<end>

segment.source: The stupid pipeworker even burned our best barrel!<end>
segment.target: The stupid pipeworker even burned our best barrel!<end>

segment.source: Wish Ring Wyrm ate Him whole. Would digest His fat ass for seven years.<end>
segment.target: Wish Ring Wyrm ate Him whole. Would digest His fat ass for seven years.<end>

segment.source: He gave me a single granddaughter! He's as good as impotent!<end>
segment.target: He gave me a single granddaughter! He's as good as impotent!<end>

segment.source: And what do I get for all my advice? An empty bottle flyin' my way. Empty!<end>
segment.target: And what do I get for all my advice? An empty bottle flyin' my way. Empty!<end>

segment.source: Gauntlet's for pansies and no-goods. *He* loves it, the dormant-brained drop-off. ::Spits.::<end>
segment.target: Gauntlet's for pansies and no-goods. *He* loves it, the dormant-brained drop-off. ::Spits.::<end>
